claim_rule: This registry makes cross-language ownership, documentation and verification gaps explicit. Registration or document presence grants no compatibility, security, durability, operational or production credit.

components.authority: Rust package boundaries are enumerated by docs/status/MODULE_DOCUMENTATION.json and docs/development/RUST_PACKAGE_AUTHORITY.json.
components.architecture: One target composition root, stable core and adapter boundaries, bounded resources and explicit temporary-package convergence.
components.failure_model: Strong types, fail-closed state transitions, stable domain errors, bounded retries and explicit cancellation.
components.security_boundary: No unsafe code or production private cryptographic primitive without accepted exception; secrets are redacted and provider-scoped.
components.operations: Process packages define readiness, drain and diagnostics; libraries expose no untracked global tasks.
known_gaps: module README depth remains uneven
isolated workspaces and temporary gate packages require convergence
the unique production composition root is not yet accepted

components.authority: Official Nakama plus the first-party Go plugin remains the currently proven broad runnable path; it is not target Rust-server evidence.
components.architecture: Nakama plugin entrypoints, authoritative match and World transition fixtures remain isolated from target Rust authority.
components.failure_model: No target-profile fallback, generation fencing, exact command identity, bounded retry and explicit quarantine.
components.security_boundary: No production secret or private authority transfer to World; current Go code is migration input and rollback authority only.
components.operations: Compose and fault-lab paths exercise current plugin behavior; final topology removes the Go server/plugin loader.
known_gaps: Go packages do not yet have per-package maintenance documents
complete Runtime source migration is open
real multi-node and long-duration World evidence is open

components.authority: migrations is the only production DDL authority; database/schema/v2 is non-authoritative design history.
components.architecture: Separate PostgreSQL and CockroachDB profiles bind the same logical invariants but retain profile-specific SQL, retry and operations evidence.
components.failure_model: Serializable transactions, revision and generation predicates, exact receipt replay, no partial command/event/outbox commit.
components.security_boundary: Verify-full production TLS, least-privilege database identities, redacted URLs and no secrets in evidence.
components.operations: Apply, introspect, backup, PITR, restore, rollback fencing and profile failover require separate retained packets.
known_gaps: complete catalog data dictionary and invariant-negative matrix are open
production PITR, RPO and RTO are not accepted
CockroachDB cannot inherit PostgreSQL evidence

components.authority: Versioned schemas and vectors define bounded public/internal observations but do not independently prove runtime behavior.
components.architecture: Generated or strict adapters translate wire values into versioned commands and stable errors without direct repository access.
components.failure_model: Malformed, duplicate, oversized, stale and incompatible inputs fail closed with profile-specific observable outcomes.
components.security_boundary: Identity, authorization, ACL, sequence, money, version, cursor, error and durable-effect fields cannot be normalized away.
components.operations: Schema changes require compatibility classification, consumer mapping, retained vectors and an explicit deprecation path.
known_gaps: complete generated API and RTAPI bindings are open
consumer/version lifecycle documentation is incomplete
all denominator families remain independently unlocked

components.authority: Immutable source identities, observations and reviewed normalizers provide comparison inputs; synthetic fixtures alone grant no compatibility credit.
components.architecture: Immutable and minimally instrumented Nakama lanes run isolated databases from identical logical seeds and produce schema-valid observations.
components.failure_model: Source, image, environment, fixture, attempt or artifact identity mismatch invalidates the observation; unexplained P0/P1 divergence blocks promotion.
components.security_boundary: Synthetic credentials only, no production PII or secrets, and normalizers cannot hide security or durable-effect differences.
components.operations: Images, patches, runs, artifacts, expiry and independent decisions are retained by digest.
known_gaps: real immutable/instrumented ten-run equivalence is open
real JavaScript and Lua engine observations are open
normalizer and evidence acceptance remain independent blockers

components.authority: Control scripts validate source and evidence contracts but cannot grant human acceptance or administrator facts.
components.architecture: Standard-library validators reject ambiguous JSON, stale identity, missing inputs, silent skips and unsupported state transitions.
components.failure_model: Missing, empty, skipped, cancelled, stale, malformed or identity-mismatched inputs fail closed.
components.security_boundary: Untrusted PR code never receives administrator credentials; validators do not fabricate reviewers or accepted evidence.
components.operations: Aggregate and focused workflows execute tools against exact candidates and retain bounded diagnostics.
known_gaps: many one-purpose scripts still need reusable library convergence
tool-level maintenance docs are uneven
control-plane growth must not substitute for product implementation

components.authority: Workflow success is execution input; required checks, rulesets, reviews and evidence admission remain separate decision surfaces.
components.architecture: Closed-set candidate and prospective-merge workflows bind source, workflow definition, run, job, attempt and artifact identities.
components.failure_model: Zero-job, duplicate-name, stale-head, stale-base, cancelled, skipped and same-name impersonation paths receive no credit.
components.security_boundary: Least-privilege workflow permissions, pinned actions, bounded artifact upload and no administrator token in PR execution.
components.operations: Branch inventory, aggregate collection, artifact retention and no-bypass read-back are separately controlled.
known_gaps: complete administration-scoped governance read-back is external
conflict-free reviewer capacity is external
workflow-family consolidation remains desirable after admission stability

components.authority: Current compose and fault-lab files are bounded development evidence inputs, not production topology approval.
components.architecture: Current Nakama/Go and candidate Rust paths remain explicitly separated through shadow, canary and ownership phases.
components.failure_model: Startup dependency, readiness, drain, node loss, database loss and external-effect ambiguity stop promotion and preserve the current authority.
components.security_boundary: No production credentials in compose, synthetic fixtures only, loopback exposure by default and explicit TLS identities.
components.operations: Backup, PITR, HA, upgrade, capacity, endurance, canary, rollback and incident procedures require independently accepted rehearsals.
known_gaps: production manifests and secret-manager integration are open
multi-node HA and rolling upgrade are open
24h, 72h and 7d endurance are open

components.authority: Machine records state what is present and accepted; editing them cannot create the underlying execution, review or administrator fact.
components.architecture: Evidence binds exact source, tree, workflow, run, jobs, environment, artifacts, limitations, expiry and independent decisions.
components.failure_model: Duplicate, expired, unreviewed, wrong-target, incomplete or legacy evidence is rejected and cannot derive a passing gate.
components.security_boundary: Artifacts exclude secrets and production PII; evidence producers cannot independently accept their own packets.
components.operations: Admission, supersession, expiry and post-merge retention are explicit transactions with immutable digests.
known_gaps: accepted evidence entry count remains zero
reviewer capacity and governance read-back are external
post-merge main evidence cannot exist before ordinary protected admission
